candidate_decisions.reason: All eight nominated branches have one-to-one activation traces. The four unresolved context branches name exact 110:1 word coordinates and return through focus words, while the four focus branches have supplied facets. The anti-triumphal response is materially distinct and remains qualified by the legacy HFT provenance.

All seven nominated branches have one-to-one traces linking the focus commands to the opening and grouped ingress. The opening-as-threshold change is distinct from anti-credit, and every unresolved context branch has an exact coordinate and focus return.

All eight branches are traced to the visible scene in 110:2 and to focus responses in 110:3. The distinction between observable entry and unobservable interior has a specific epistemic payoff and is not a duplicate of the public-performance finding.

All seven branches have exact pericope traces. The focus praise, disavowal, and forgiveness branches contact the supplied public-gaze, visible-audience, and grouped-crowd coordinates, producing a distinct performance-economy reading with an explicit boundary.

All eight branches are traced through the grouped entrants in 110:2 and the focus commands. The nurture, shelter, invitation, and incorporation relation gives the addressee a distinct receiving responsibility and remains separate from collective-cover and individual-forgiveness readings.

All seven branches are explicitly traced, including the non-dominant split-root accounting branch. The legal-economic relation has a distinct moral-ledger payoff; its exploratory inference and attributed context branches remain visible rather than being suppressed.

All nine branches have exact traces connecting focus movement, cloud and covering images, and continuing response to the supplied aid, opening, entry, and group coordinates. The hydraulic analogy has a specific changed reading and is bounded as an exploratory image.

All five branches have exact traces from achieved aid and opening to the focus forgiveness command and its temporal predicate. The medical relapse branch is explicitly retained as an analogy because its focus carrier, coordinates, and post-success boundary are supplied.

All five branches have exact traces connecting the focus imperative and enduring predicate to repeated coming and grouped entry. The counted-waves image is materially distinct from the hydraulic image and is retained with its explicit serial-practice boundary.

All five branches have exact traces linking the complete crowd, mixed incorporation, and grouped entry to the focus forgiveness and Lord-title carriers. The collective-cover payoff is distinct from pastoral reception and preserves the personal forgiveness reading as its boundary.

findings.title: Received victory turns into an anti-credit response
findings.claim: The favorable event is received as divinely supplied aid and opening, so the response purifies human credit rather than treating success as personal merit.
findings.mechanism: The focus imperative سبّح carries transcendence and disavowal, حَمْدِ carries the supplied praise-credit facet, رَبِّكَ carries ownership and governance, and ٱسْتَغْفِرْ carries protection from consequence. These focus carriers meet the pericope's arrival, aid, divine-source, and victorious-opening occurrences, making the commands an ethical response to success received rather than manufactured.
findings.reader_payoff: The move from success to praise and forgiveness becomes a precise protocol for surrendering the credit success invites, while the ordinary command to praise and seek forgiveness remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT interpretation of the pericope, not a claim that the focus verbs lexically mean anti-triumphalism in every setting. The unresolved context branch meanings remain attributed, and the finding does not deny ordinary gratitude after aid.

epistemic.reason: The support has exact supplied Arabic anchors and complete coordinate traces, but its contextual roles and several branch records are legacy-unbound HFT nominations; focus facets are independently present and the inference is therefore retained with qualification.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Tanrı'yı her türlü eksiklikten uzak sayma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'yı her türlü kötülük ve eksiklikten uzak sayıp yüceltme.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus imperative سبّح carries the supplied declaration of God's freedom from defect.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 110:1:3 occurrence supplies the received aid that precedes the response.
branch_activations.activation: The command to declare transcendence meets the received aid, so the response clears the human claim from an event already framed as granted.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Praise begins as a clearing of triumphalist self-attribution.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is retained for this focus contact; it is not generalized to every possible movement sense of سبّح.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iyiliğini başa kakıp kendine pay çıkarma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi yaptığı iyiliği başkasının başına kakar ve bundan kendine değer payı çıkarır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun حَمْدِ carries the supplied form in which benefaction can become a claim of personal value.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 110:1:3 aid occurrence supplies the benefaction context that can be appropriated.
branch_activations.activation: Praise attached to the Lord is read against aid received from outside the addressee, exposing the conversion of benefaction into self-credit.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The command redirects praise before received aid can become a personal balance of merit.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the supplied self-credit facet, not a replacement of the ordinary praise meaning with blame.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus title رَبِّكَ carries ownership and governing authority in relation to the addressee.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 110:1:4 divine-name occurrence supplies the independent divine-source contact for the aid and opening.
branch_activations.activation: The possessive Lord-title places the achieved event under the one who owns and governs it, so the addressee receives the outcome rather than owning its source.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The response returns agency and credit to the Lord named by the focus address.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding uses the relational Lord-title in this pericope and does not claim that the addressee has no agency in every context.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bağışlamanın sonucu, suç işleyeni cezanın ona ulaşmasından korumaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus imperative ٱسْتَغْفِرْ carries seeking protection from the consequence of an offense.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 110:1:5 victorious-opening occurrence supplies the success pressure under which self-credit can become an offense.
branch_activations.activation: Seeking protection from consequence meets the opening's pressure, so forgiveness repairs the appropriation that success can leave behind.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Istighfar treats self-credit as a live moral residue inside genuine victory.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not turn the focus command into a general accusation; it adds a bounded consequence-sensitive response to success.

findings.title: The opening begins a maintained passage
findings.claim: The opening in 110:1 functions as a threshold into continuing grouped ingress, so praise and forgiveness operate as the practices that sustain what victory has begun.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches for worship, nurture, temporal being, and settled continuity meet the context branches for opening-as-beginning, ingress, and grouped arrival. The sequence from فتح through imperfect plural entry to the focus imperatives changes the commands from a terminal commemoration into an ongoing response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why commands follow the apparent culmination: the opening has created an afterlife of responsibility in which repeated entry requires continuing practice.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of praise, forgiveness, and divine return remains present. The threshold and maintenance relation is a qualified contextual reading, not a claim that فتح always means a beginning or that the focus commands have only a maintenance function.

epistemic.reason: The support supplies complete coordinates and exact Arabic anchors, with focus branch facets available; the contextual semantic roles remain legacy-unbound HFT attribution.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 110:2:3 occurrence supplies continuing human ingress through the opened passage.
branch_activations.activation: Worship as continuing practice meets ongoing ingress, giving the response a maintenance function after the threshold opens.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Praise becomes repeatable practice for what the opening sets in motion.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not remove the ordinary command to glorify God or assert that all worship is merely aftercare.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The response attends to the gradual completion of what enters through the threshold.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus branch is applied through this context and does not replace the title's ordinary relational sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Praise and forgiveness maintain an opening whose consequences continue to arrive.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a collocational contextual activation; the bare form is not assigned a general stability meaning.

branch_activations.carrier: Attributed HFT carrier role: Supplies a beginning that opens what comes next, converting the apparent culmination into a threshold.

branch_activations.activation: The context opening meets the focus's established temporal relation, changing the event from endpoint to beginning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The commands govern what the opening starts.

branch_activations.carrier: Attributed HFT carrier role: Supplies actual ingress, giving the opened threshold a continuing human traffic.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The opened passage generates an ongoing social responsibility for praise and forgiveness.

findings.title: Visible entry leaves an interior uncertified
findings.claim: The witnessed influx is real at the level of visible entry, while the focus response keeps that public sight from certifying every entrant's interior state.
findings.mechanism: The focus praise facet for tested fitness, the disavowal facet of tasbih, and the protective-cover facet of istighfar meet supplied context roles for sight, manifest people, inwardness, concealed impairment, and entrusted assent. The singular witness sees plural bodies, and the focus commands redirect that witness toward God and protective repair.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the truth of the public scene from the limits of what public sight knows, so praise and forgiveness become epistemic discipline as well as devotion.
findings.containment: The visible ingress remains affirmed. Interior uncertainty is a qualified pericope reading, not a claim that the scene is false or that entry carries no religious significance.

epistemic.reason: The support has exact 110:2 and 110:3 anchors and complete coordinate traces, with a supplied focus facet; the hidden-interior roles are legacy-unbound contextual nominations.

branch_activations.activation: Praise after testing meets sight that reaches the public scene, making the visible crowd a standard that may still require discernment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus response acknowledges what is seen while leaving room for what sight cannot test.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is not used to deny the goodness of the visible influx or to assert a verdict about any individual.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Seeing the influx supplies evidence without supplying complete interior knowledge.

branch_activations.activation: Inwardness meets protective forgiveness, so the command addresses an interior that public entry alone cannot expose.

branch_activations.carrier: Attributed HFT carrier role: Supplies assent and entrustment, functioning as an inward relation deeper than spatial entry alone.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus praise occurrence at 110:3:2:2 supplies the relation that evaluates the visible event.
branch_activations.activation: Inward assent meets visible entry, making the public scene insufficient as a complete account of the inner relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness sees entry while the deeper quality of assent remains entrusted beyond sight.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch has no independent registry facet and remains attributed.

findings.title: Public success can become a stage
findings.claim: The larger and more visible the success, the more urgently the focus response redirects praise away from a human audience and toward the Lord.
findings.mechanism: The focus self-credit facet of حَمْدِ, the disavowal facet of سبّح, and the consequence-protection facet of ٱسْتَغْفِرْ meet attributed opening-as-display, people-facing gaze, visible humanity, and grouped crowds. Their contact creates an audience economy that the commands interrupt.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how sincere success and public performance can touch, and why the focus commands actively relocate the gaze rather than merely follow the event privately.
findings.containment: This finding does not turn the scene into vanity or replace the ordinary devotional response. The audience-performance relation is a medium-qualified contextual reading supported by exact coordinates and remains distinct from the broader anti-credit finding.

epistemic.reason: The support supplies exact pericope anchors and complete branch traces; its public-performance roles and the unresolved context branches are legacy-unbound HFT nominations.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Praise becomes a deliberate withdrawal of credit from the human audience.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is not used to equate every praise act with boastfulness.

findings.title: The influx becomes a charge of reception
findings.claim: Grouped entrants become a pastoral charge: the focus response trains the addressee to receive, shelter, and patiently incorporate those entering.
findings.mechanism: The focus Lord-title's nurture facet, its supplied foster-care facet, the protective-cover facet of forgiveness, and the focus return-call branch meet attributed roles for de-estrangement, outsider mixing, obedience, and grouped people. The plural entrants and singular addressee turn private commands into a responsibility for reception.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the crowds as people whose incorporation has an aftercare dimension, so praise and forgiveness shape a mode of receiving rather than remaining only private interior acts.
findings.containment: Personal praise and forgiveness remain the plain focus commands. The caretaker relation is a qualified contextual resonance, not a replacement of personal repentance with a demographic duty or a claim that every entrant is incomplete.

epistemic.reason: The support provides exact coordinates for all eight traces and two focus branch records with supplied facets, while the contextual incorporation roles are legacy-unbound HFT nominations.

branch_activations.activation: Nurture meets incorporation, making the divine relation a pattern for patient development after entry.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The addressee's response can accompany entrants through a process rather than merely observe their arrival.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains a contextual facet of the Lord-title and does not erase the plain divine referent.

findings.containment: This is exploratory and uses the non-dominant split-root mapping as an analogy. It does not claim that رَبِّكَ lexically means financial surplus here, nor does it deny the ordinary meaning of victory, praise, or forgiveness.

friction_notes: All ten assigned records are reconstructed legacy_unbound HFT nominations. Exact Arabic confirms supplied surface contact, while HFT segmentations, contextual roles, and unresolved branch meanings remain attributed; this qualifies the findings without suppressing any exact surviving trace.

The packet reports nine of nine focus word alignments resolved. No staged reader responses, reader walks, cross-run publication, or separate word-analysis candidate inventory is present in the supplied packet, so no contribution from those source families is inferred.

Automatic host basmala 110:0 was present for Phase 1. Explicit external ayat 1:2-1:7 were quarantined during Phase 1 and reviewed as the Phase 2 overlay; they add no supplied candidate, support, or connection with a specific carrier-trigger-focus contact beyond the retained native pericope findings, so no external overlay finding is retained.

The packet explicitly records split-root mappings for ر ب ب, ت و ب, and ر ء ي. Non-dominant mapped branches are retained only where the HFT trace supplies an exact coordinate and focus return, and their source qualification remains visible.

The two reciprocal connection nominations were reassessed from the focus direction and landed on the opening-threshold and visible-entry findings; source-direction labels were treated as nominations rather than decisions.
